full_page.content:
1936, November
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 152 Cont.
Nov. 22 Jack Strachan - 36 vanished 15 months ago. Mother, sister and friends await - have in vain awaited his return. Car found on street in perfect condition.
22 Elaine McCardy - 9 - infantile par ...... since September a yr. ago. Now home but very poorly - has to be carried like a baby. Father a convert.
Mrs. Lucile Sweeney - 32 - bad asthma
Joseph Cyr & Sister. .. Thanks for prayers - former ( temporarily) insane had no accident while driving car. Please pray further for success ... etc.
Theodore Wirkus - 17 -
Marie O'Brien - 27 - ascetic. stroke - operation - fearful pains off & on now almost 2 yrs. Father ... now back to Church and sacra- ment after 32 yrs ... Brothers.
Page 153 Nov. Sarah Lambrecht - 17 - good girl gone from home now over a week - no trace found of her where-abouts.
Walter Schneider - 28 - serious stomach troubles.
Mrs. Evelyn Smeader - 36 - fears loss of breast - said to be can- cerous and diabetes, has four small children ....
Emilia Felzstone - 36 To-day - thought to be dying 4 weeks ago Mother made a promise of something if she were spared ... OK .. . Mrs. Margaret O'Hare - 39 . . nerveous . . .
Charles Soules - 21 - High-blood pressure - kidney - etc. Opera- tion Thursday, Expected - blind also.
Page 154 Nov. 28 Dorothy Nees - about 40 - blind now for two yrs but happy .... from Penn'a.
Henrietta Fortin - 9 - infantile paral ... operation last Aug. 2nd threatened.
Chas. Soules - 21
